name: Dumbbell Lying Leg Curl
steps: Set a dumbbell upright on the floor at one end of a flat bench and lie face down on the pad.
Position your knees just past the bench edge and grip the dumbbell handle between your feet with its upper end supported on your soles.
Brace your hips against the bench and bend your knees to curl the dumbbell toward your glutes.
Lower your feet until your knees are nearly straight, then set the dumbbell down before releasing it.
tips: Keep your feet squeezed tightly around the dumbbell throughout every repetition.
Press your hips into the pad instead of letting your lower back arch as you curl.
